source_review.pinned_sql:
with distinct_tenant as (
      select
        distinct tenant_id,
        display_name,
        subscription_id,
        _ctx
      from
        azure_tenant
    )
    select
      id as resource,
      case
        when (value)::int >= 60 then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when (value)::int >= 60 then t.display_name || ' lockout duration is at least 60 seconds.'
        else
          t.display_name || ' lockout duration is less than 60 seconds.'
      end as reason,
      t.tenant_id
      ${replace(local.common_dimensions_subscription_id_qualifier_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "t.")}
    from
      distinct_tenant as t,
      azuread_directory_setting
    where
      name = 'LockoutDurationInSeconds';
